name: – Isabel Wiseler-Lima – § 41 – Am 55
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2024
part_text: 41. Stresses the importance of closing the financing gap that would enable countries to meet their SDG 4 targets on quality education and ensure access to education for all children and young people, including access to education in their mother tongue; deplores any initiatives by non-governmental organisations (NGOs) and media organisations that violate children’s rights to healthy and natural development through the promotion of so-called affirmative care; calls on the EU institutions to defend the healthy and natural development of minors across the world;
